ops.title: Honor fresh removal intent after an untouched cleanup job fails identity
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccx_targeted_stack_io. Six actual fresh supported Remove requests rejoined old identity-blocked cleanup jobs and blocked again because captured HEAD predates the current checkout, despite current tree inode matching. Evidence: ccx-all-valid-inactive-registration-cohort-bookend.private.json and ccx-all304-quiet-owned-retirement-bookend.private.json. Engine.remove calls revive(sittingAt()) before new Pend; sittingAt verifies only path and tree ID, not a newly captured HEAD. No supported cancel/forget endpoint. Next: bounded fresh Remove admission that does not rejoin untouched identity-blocked jobs with no retirement intent; preserve immutable old Expected/HEAD and capture/guard the current explicit request in a new job. Defer, active and already-retired ownership semantics stay unchanged. Root informed of narrow vs explicit supersede API choice; independent security review required. No physical deletion or identity waiver.

ops.text: Actual Git changed-HEAD fresh removal creates a currently captured job while preserving old immutable capture and current activity/replacement/retirement protection.
Independent security review plus CI, merge, release and local helper adoption verified.
Reprocess proven inactive old-HEAD blocked cohort through supported API and verify registration-only results with payload deletion paused.
